claim: Measured formatter replay of three previously recorded accepted live proposals; no new model calls or grading changes.

before.title: Designer layout proposal
before.description: Preview bedroom walls in a proposed muted sage #A3B18A, retaining all furniture positions and rotations. Wall colouring affects both faces and all segments sharing each selected source_id, including the adjoining living-room, kitchen and bathroom faces. No furniture purchases; paint and labour are unquoted.

after.title: Fresh colour for the bedroom
after.description: I’ve given 5 wall sections a fresh colour, keeping the layout just as it is. No furniture purchases are needed. The trade-off: the colour covers both sides of each selected wall, including shared walls.
after.notes: Existing access problems remain; this proposal does not make them worse. Paint and labour are not priced.

rows.request: make the living room feel bigger

before.title: Designer layout proposal
before.description: Make the living room feel bigger with a zero-cost rearrangement retaining all existing furniture. Group seating at the lower wall and move the coffee table into this zone, enlarging the clear centre and circulation with a generous sofa access gap. Leave bedroom positions and rotations unchanged. Solar orientation and door-sweep clearance remain unverified.

after.title: More room in the living and dining area
after.description: I’ve moved the sofa, coffee table and chair into new positions. Your largest open area grows from 22.68 to 30.24 m². No furniture purchases are needed. The trade-off: the seats face each other less directly.
after.notes: Sun direction still needs checking. Door swings still need checking. Existing access problems remain; this proposal does not make them worse.

rows.request: add an armchair for reading by the window

before.title: Designer layout proposal
before.description: Add one reading armchair beside the living-room window, facing into the room, retaining all existing furniture in its original position and rotation. Budget unconfirmed; catalog price 80000 AMD is mock pricing, not a shop quotation. Solar orientation and door-sweep clearance unverified.

after.title: A reading corner by the window
after.description: I’ve added a chair beside the window, giving you a place to settle in with a book. Your largest open area stays at 22.68 m². Catalog price: 80,000 ֏. The trade-off: a tight 21 cm gap behind the chair.
after.notes: Sample catalog price, not a shop quote. Budget not set. Sun direction still needs checking. Door swings still need checking. Existing access problems remain; this proposal does not make them worse.
